name: manual_110c59
claim: Validate an environment-file instruction against the installer that creates the file and every launcher that consumes it. Bash sourcing and PowerShell literal-assignment parsing are different contracts; absent operator-local files permit a repository comparison, not claims of inspecting private contents or executing shell substitutions.

decisions.notes: Legacy Orama #473 corrected the Hermes source filename to the actual installer output while documenting the Windows literal reader. Both private candidate files were absent in the cloud; no secrets were sourced. https://github.com/diazMelgarejo/orama-system/pull/473#discussion_r4465645712
